mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
